name: Fadal
description: Fadal is a MUDA-approved plotted development at Shyadanahalli, reached from KRS Main Road, where buyers build their own homes. Forty-three plots sit on 11,722 sq m — two acres and thirty-six guntas — with a tenth of the site given to park and nine-metre roads throughout. The layout has final approval and every site is released. It is Vaastu and Feng Shui compliant.

contentWarnings: Specifications omitted. The live page lists interior finishes — imported marble, wooden flooring to bedrooms, engineered wooden doors, floor-to-ceiling glass — on a development that sells bare land. It also refers to 'partial villas'. This is another project's content and is not carried over.
The live page duplicates its 'Electrical' specification group.
The live page shows an empty Amenities section. The amenities here are taken from the brief, sourced from the old WordPress page.
Fadal ranks in search on the old WordPress URL. That page carries Happiness 2's villa floor plans under a 'Master Plan' heading. The redirect matters (§13).

Figures taken from the FINAL approved layout and 100% release order, which supersedes the provisional drawing. The provisional sheet showed 44 sites; the final approval records 43 — matching the published figure. Land use: 54.06% residential, 30.36% roads, 10.03% park, 5.01% civic amenities, 0.54% not in enjoyment.
Eleven plots are irregular ("9.0 × odd") on the approved drawing and have no single stated dimension. They are counted but not sized.
All sites released: the 100% release order is on file. The approach is marked "From KRS Main Road" on the drawing, which is why the filter keeps that label while the address gives Shyadanahalli.
The sales brochure says 3 acres and 44 plots. The final MUDA approval and 100% release order say 2 acres 36 guntas and 43. The approval wins here; the brochure needs correcting.

Health and leisure entries are the brochure's travel times. Its kilometre column could not be used: the PDF's text layer drops the decimal point, so it reads "Infosys-49 km 12 mins". Re-key those from the printed brochure rather than trusting a reconstruction.

The brochure gives the address as Survey no 129/2, Shyadanahally, KRS Main Road, behind Chamundeswari Railway Layout, near Vikrant Tyres, Mysore 570003. The site says Survey No. 129 and 570016. Confirm the survey subdivision and the PIN.
The brochure master plan sizes the park at 1,270.83 sq m and civic amenities at 634.93 sq m.
